description:
Search for people on LinkedIn — profile lookup, search, research, or company employee extraction.

Modes:
- profile: Get a single LinkedIn profile by URL
- search: Search people by natural language query (e.g., "CTO fintech Israel")
- research: Deep research on a LinkedIn profile
- company: Extract employees from a LinkedIn company page

This is a convenience wrapper for submit_job with type=spiderPeople.

company_url.description: LinkedIn company URL (required for company mode)

icp_description.description: Ideal Customer Profile for lead scoring

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (required for profile/research modes)

person_name.description: Person name (optional, extracted from LinkedIn if not provided)

product_description.description: Your product description for lead scoring

profile_mode.description: Employee detail level: short ($4/1K), full ($8/1K), full_email ($12/1K)

search_query.description: Natural language search query (required for search mode)

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: search_people
